Name: Jeremiah the Priest
Summary: Priest who sealed the covenant (Nehemiah 10:2) and returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua (Nehemiah 12:1); the course of Jeremiah in Joiakim's days bears his name (Nehemiah 12:12). Not Jeremiah the prophet.
LifeLesson: A priest's name can span the return, the covenant, and the courses.
